text:
Lena Park: Starting RedLeaf adoption kickoff thread. Goal: align stakeholders, list success metrics we can measure from day 1, flag renewal/health risks, and agree on a 30/60/90 cadence. Proposed kickoff Thurs 4/8 11am PT. Who can own instrumentation and health dashboard?

Tom Berger: ITake instrumentation. Will wire up a health dashboard and shared sheet for feature adoption. Thurs 11am OK.

Nadia Singh: Ill own compliance/controls checklist. Need to confirm whether RedLeaf needs processor-level DPA + EU data residency. That affects deployment mode.

Evan Cole: Sales note: renewal window is in 9 months; theyreachable but price-sensitivity flagged. If we can show early usage growth and security signoffs, renewal probability increases.

Lena Park: Early success metrics proposal (comment inline):
- activation rate (dev keys issued / total invited) target 40% in 30d
- 7-day retention of active calls > 30%
- health_score >= 75 (current baseline 62)
- top 5 intents covered by caching to reduce cost by 15%

Tom Berger: Copy. I'll add those to the dashboard. For health_score calc I'm proposing: 40% adoption weight, 30% latency/SLOs, 20% errors, 10% support volume.

Nadia Singh: Risk flag: if they require EU-only VPC with HSM, deployment lead time 3-4 weeks after legal + infra signoff. Put on the watchlist.

Evan Cole: Adding commercial risk: they're considering a competitor's managed offering for SOC requirements. We should prioritize the compliance checklist and an exec briefing.

Lena Park: Proposed onboarding pre-reads to send to RL before kickoff:
1) short questionnaire: primary use-cases + top 10 prompts
2) expected daily volume and peak windows
3) IP/peering & contact for network allowlist
4) draft DPA + contact for legal

Tom Berger: Action: I'll create the adoption dashboard and a shareable CSV template for prompts. ETA: Tue EOD.

Nadia Singh: Action: I'll post the compliance checklist + what we need for SOC2 / EU residency. ETA: Wed noon.

Evan Cole: Action: I'll schedule an exec briefing slot for next week and loop in the account exec. Also will surface competitor talk to AM.

Lena Park: Cadence suggestion: weekly 30-min sync (Mon 8:30am PT), milestone reviews at 30/60/90. Quick 15-min daily standups first week if needed.

Tom Berger: Agree. Also will instrument two canaries for latency & error spikes and wire alerts to eng-oncall.

Nadia Singh: Note: encryption key management - customer insists on KMS integration. Samir (eng infra) needs to be invited to kickoff.

Evan Cole: I'll add Samir to the calendar invite.

Lena Park: Adding action/owners here for tracking:
- Lena Park: run kickoff, collate RL stakeholders + questionnaire (due before call)
- Tom Berger: adoption dashboard + prompt CSV (due Tue EOD)
- Nadia Singh: compliance checklist + KMS requirements (due Wed noon)
- Evan Cole: exec briefing + AM alignment (schedule by Fri)

onboard-bot: Ticket #CS-7364 created for RedLeaf adoption kickoff. Owner: Lena Park. Due: 2026-04-07. Labels: onboarding, adoption, renewal-watch.

Lena Park: OK team, I'll post the kickoff agenda and the questionnaire link before EOD. Please flag any dependencies here. :raised_hands:

Tom Berger: Will post dashboard link when ready. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Nadia Singh: Noted, will ping eng-security for HSM/KMS integration slot.

Evan Cole: Sending calendar invite now.

Lena Park: Thanks everyone. We'll capture customer feedback during the first workshop and add to the feedback tracker for product.

Tom Berger: Suggest we run a short Net Promoter style question at week 2 to quantify early satisfaction.

Nadia Singh: Agreed. Add support volume and top error types to the feedback tracker.

Evan Cole: Done. Invite accepted.

Lena Park: Thread closed for now  will reopen if blockers appear.
